disposition_reason: The source-code Figure 4 discrimination endpoint is selected as the explicit method primary. Final-publication/version equivalence, authentic complete guide/well score support and a source-grounded full-panel superiority rule are unresolved. Original-fold construction is useful but supplied-score replay and the prospective whole-plate/four-line evaluator do not establish a fitted final-paper baseline.

source_paper.title: Network-aware self-supervised learning enables high-content phenotypic screening for genetic modifiers of neuronal activity dynamics

evidence.locator: Public article metadata, Code availability, dataset references

Per-guide binary AUROC, half-well complementary folds, scaler and classifier semantics, WT WTC11/Patient comparison.
Archive provides plate statistics, treatment mappings, checkpoints, embeddings/manual features and processed plate/well/FOV Zarr traces.
Current registration requires 52 genes/four lines, whereas local evaluator explicitly implements prospective whole-plate policy; no authentic reference run.

target.description: Recreate and improve the original source Figure 4 guide-versus-non-targeting-control discrimination endpoint: complete guide-by-donor-by-fold AUROC outputs for Plexus and manual features in WT WTC11 and WT Patient strata, under the original source well-split and preprocessing protocol. Final-paper/archive equivalence remains unresolved.

dataset.description: Zenodo 15809433 v2 and predecessor 14714574 are source data references; authenticate the selected release and final-paper Figure 4 equivalence before admission. Do not silently substitute one version or a convenient subset. Original plate/well/FOV/treatment/trace and representation artifacts require exact provenance.

cohort.description: Retain all Figure 4 eligible guides/wells in WT WTC11 and WT Patient donor strata, including source-defined skipped/insufficient-support cases with reasons. The complete authentic roster is unresolved; neither all four lines nor all 52 registered genes is assumed to be the Figure 4 cohort.

split.description: Pinned Figure 4 source resets legacy NumPy seed 0 for each of four representation-family/donor calls, draws half non-targeting well locations and then half each sorted guide locations. First-fold training is class-balanced by downsampling; its model scores the complete held-out set. Reciprocal training uses the unbalanced held-out set and scores only the balanced first-fold training subset. Discarded training rows do not reappear. Balancing consumes the same RNG stream as later well draws. Preserve >8 first-training observations per class, source one-class reciprocal skip behavior and literal non-targeting self-exclusion. Authentic ordered identities and final-publication equivalence are unresolved.

inputs.description: Original processed neuronal traces/spikes/masks and plate/well/FOV/treatment metadata, with the same declared representation and algorithm-bearing-artifact exposure in both conditions. Official embeddings/checkpoints are not raw neural observations; if shared, freeze identical bytes and source/training provenance as explicit common assisted inputs before either candidate. Otherwise neither condition receives them implicitly.

preprocessing.description: Preserve original typical-variation normalization, aggregation and full-input StandardScaler before well splitting, including its transductive exposure. Manual loc_id=well_id+"_"+zarr_file; Plexus loc_id uses first two aggregate_by underscore tokens plus well_id. Authenticate representation/checkpoint training exposure, preprocessing receipts, original input ordering and final-paper equivalence. Training-only scaling or corrected folds constitute a separately named extension.

metric.description: Original guide-positive AUROC from sklearn roc_curve and auc over source classifier probabilities, preserving both complementary but asymmetric well-fold evaluations, donor strata and all eligible guides. 0.8 is a plotted display cutoff, not the author performance baseline. Control-only/null diagnostic outputs have fidelity roles, not independent maximize targets.

aggregation.description: Preserve the complete original per-guide, donor-stratified, two-fold AUROC vectors for Plexus and manual features with source eligibility/skip states and shared controls. No complete final-publication vector, exact panel contrast or defensible full-screen scalar has yet been authenticated. Do not substitute a new mean, count above 0.8 or significant-gene count.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Figure 4 complete per-guide/donor/fold AUROC performance panel, with source support and skip diagnostics; no replacement scalar aggregate

published_baseline.description: Recover complete final-publication Plexus and manual-feature AUROC vectors and exact source panel mapping. No numeric vector/scalar is authenticated; 0.8, guide counts and gene-discovery significance are not author performance baselines.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Pinned Figure4/figure_4.py supplies the original computation route; original-figure4-v1 reconstructs source splits and scores supplied observations but does not fit representations/classifiers or authenticate final-paper equivalence. Full original-data author fit and complete source score vectors remain unrecovered.

minimum_effect.rationale: Unresolved until source reference variability and the complete original performance panel are authenticated. Freeze a scientifically justified effect/uncertainty policy before candidates; no universal numeric margin or new scalar is invented.

uncertainty.method: Unresolved: paired inference must respect shared control wells and biological plate/batch dependence.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological plate/batch; wells nested within these; cells and reciprocal folds are not independent replicates.
uncertainty.rationale: The original fold results share source data and controls. Biological independence and a predeclared familywise comparison rule must be established.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate final-paper/code/data-version equivalence and complete original WT donor guide/well support; preserve original full-input scaling, asymmetric reciprocal folds, eligibility and skip semantics.

Reproduce the complete source Plexus and manual-feature panel before declaring author calibration. Candidate classifier predictions, eligibility, convergence and skips must be independently produced/verified, not trusted self-reported metadata.

Freeze one identical source-compatible observation/assistance profile for paper_data and paper_data_author_code. Any official weights/embeddings must be named identical common assisted artifacts with training-overlap provenance, or withheld from both; code condition adds only the pinned official implementation.

Predeclare complete-panel superiority against the strongest relevant original author representation/method and both published/reproduced reference panels, with meaningful effect and dependence-aware uncertainty. Beating manual features alone or cherry-picked guides is insufficient.

Preserve all required source controls/diagnostics without optimizing null effects. No win from additional significant genes, p-values, 0.8 cutoff counts, changed four-line/whole-plate evaluation or silently repaired preprocessing.
Implement pending panel-admission interface without an invented scalar. Paper-relative superiority is separate from a current-SOTA claim.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was source-verified; paper and rerun baselines are separate.

episode.improvement_loop: After source admission, develop representation/prediction methods within the original source observation and full-input preprocessing boundary. Keep original well protocol, original WT strata, full eligible guide support and common assistance profile; changed whole-plate or corrected-normalization experiments are separate extensions.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze code, representation/checkpoint exposure, original scaling/aggregation and classifier procedure, source fold ledger/RNG, complete support, panel criterion and effect/uncertainty rules before protected final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Independently generate and verify complete original-fold guide probabilities, original eligible/skip/convergence records and AUROC vectors on the identical source protocol. Compare with publication and authenticated author reference panels; no selected guides/folds or artificial scalar.
episode.baseline_policy: Retain original Plexus and manual-feature results separately, then apply a predeclared strongest-relevant-author full-panel policy. Original source artifacts used by the independent reference operator are disclosed separately from common candidate assistance. Prospective whole-plate scores are not original Figure 4 references.
